entities.name: Superbarrio Gómez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Superbarrio Gómez is a Mexican "real-life superhero", satirist and organizer. Inspired by the Luchador wrestler El Santo, and his social-justice superhero persona in comics and movies, Superbarrio wears red tights and a red and yellow wrestler's mask. Rather than fight crime and corruption with violence, he uses his image to organize labor rallies and protests, and file petitions.
